description: Resolve a brand or @handle to one public Instagram profile — stable id, bio, links, and stats (not niche discovery). Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Serve from the 24h shared cache when available (0 credits on hit). Default true — set false to always fetch fresh.

q.description: Account name, @handle, or profile URL to resolve (min 2 characters). A leading _, accents (misión → mision), spaces and URL query strings (?igsh=…) are stripped. A q with no usable username characters is 400 BAD_REQUEST. Not a niche keyword search.

name: instagram_profile_search
